snippet.title: Coloratura - Launch Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10019531

Coloratura is out now on PS5. Play as Alex, a talented musician who has lost her sight, in a narrative adventure guided entirely by sound. Explore through PS5’s 3D Audio, solve musical puzzles and rebuild her melodies. Best played with headphones. 🎧

#ps5 #ps5games #coloratura
